usage: 蛋撻 (daan6 taat1) is used as a noun to refer to the popular Hong Kong snack, egg tart.
You can use 蛋撻 in sentences when talking about ordering or eating food.
It often appears in contexts related to restaurants, cafes, or dim sum menus.
When pluralizing in English, just add 's' to egg tart; in Cantonese, 蛋撻 stays the same regardless of quantity.
You can combine 蛋撻 with quantifiers like '一個' (jat1 go3) meaning 'one piece' to specify the amount.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 jat1 go3 daan6 taat1.
examples.meaning: I want to eat an egg tart.
